info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-Create Healthcare Appointments Book-v4-spec
info.description: The Healthcare Appointments Booking API facilitates the scheduling of medical appointments for patients within a healthcare system. This API allows users to create, manage, and book appointments efficiently, ensuring that all necessary details, such as provider information, patient data, and appointment timings, are captured. Typical consumers include healthcare professionals and patient management systems seeking to enhance their appointment workflow. By integrating this API, organizations can improve their service delivery and optimize resource allocation.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to schedule a new appointment in the system. The request must include the necessary details such as date, time, and user information. Successful booking will reserve the specified time slot for the user.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to book a new appointment. It should contain all the necessary details required for the appointment creation, including client information, appointment date and time, and any special requests or notes.

CreateHealthcareAppointmentsBookRequest.title: Appointment Booking Request

requestId.description: A unique identifier for the request.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the appointment.

customer.description: Details of the customer making the appointment.

resource.description: Identifier for the resource associated with the appointment.

priority.description: Priority level of the appointment (e.g., 1 for high priority).

amount.description: Amount to be charged for the appointment.

currency.description: Currency code for the amount (e.g., USD).

notificationRequired.description: Indicates if a notification is required for the appointment.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp when the appointment was requested.

channel.description: The channel through which the appointment was made (e.g., online, in-person).

recordIndex.description: Index of the record in the system if applicable.

CreateHealthcareAppointmentsBookRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for booking an appointment.

Customer.title: Customer Details

firstName.description: The first name of the customer.

lastName.description: The last name of the customer.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

vipCustomer.description: Indicates whether the customer is a VIP.

Customer.description: Schema representing the customer details for an appointment.

CreateHealthcareAppointmentsBookResponse.title: Appointment Booking Response

status.description: Indicates whether the appointment booking was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the booked appointment.

resultId.description: The ID of the result related to this booking.

state.description: The current state of the booking process.

processingTimeMs.description: The processing time taken for the booking in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the booking status.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the booking process.

CreateHealthcareAppointmentsBookResponse.description: Response schema for the appointment booking operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the booking.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the booking was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the booking was created through an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information related to the operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
